I farm three and a half hectares, but this plot is only point-eight-four hectares where I grow beans mixed with maize. I own this land, so I put manure on it every year from my cattle, but I will not spend cash on chemical fertilizer here — I save that for my bigger field. My wife and I will work about sixty days on this plot from planting through harvest, and I will not hire outside labor because the plot is small and wages are high. We use seed I kept from last season, we do not spray chemicals, and we do not irrigate — we wait for the rains and pull weeds by hand.
